channel.title: NoneNote
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
chore: point updates and branding at this fork

SUFeedURL still named upstream's appcast, so the updater read aimen08/noty's
releases and would have offered to replace this app with upstream's build.
It now reads ours, and the committed appcast no longer carries upstream's
1.0.8 entry, whose enclosure pointed at their DMG.

SUPublicEDKey was byte-identical to upstream's, and no Sparkle private key
existed on this machine — so a release signed by CI would have failed
verification in every installed copy, silently. The fork now has its own
EdDSA pair; the public half is in Info.plist and the private half belongs in
the SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY secret with a backup kept.

README: titled Noty and linking upstream's site and DMG, with four images
that the original fork excluded. Now NoneNote, with the screenshots restored
and upstream's MIT credit made explicit.
